info.title: Seller address query
info.description: Derived from official AliExpress documentation and SDK, not an official Swagger release.

get.description: You can use this interface to query your shipping address and return address. Please use the shipping address ID as the address ID in the input parameter of the platform logistics packaging interface.

addressType.description: 请将地址类型填写为“揽收”或“退件”，或者如果两者都适用的话用逗号将其分隔开。此接口返回的地址 ID 可用作平台物流包装接口中的地址 ID 参数。但请注意，目前“包装”接口仅要求传递“自取”类型的地址 ID，无需传递“退款”类型的地址 ID（即无需传递退货地址）。

input.desc: [{"zh_CN":"请将地址类型填写为“揽收”或“退件”，或者如果两者都适用的话用逗号将其分隔开。此接口返回的地址 ID 可用作平台物流包装接口中的地址 ID 参数。但请注意，目前“包装”接口仅要求传递“自取”类型的地址 ID，无需传递“退款”类型的地址 ID（即无需传递退货地址）。"},{"en_US":"Please fill in the address type as \"pickup\" or \"refund\", or use a comma to separate them if both are applicable. The address ID returned by this interface can be used as the address ID parameter in the platform logistics packed interface. However, please note that currently the \"packed\" interface only requires the address ID of the \"pickup\" type to be passed, and there is no need to pass the address ID of the \"refund\" type (i.e. there is no need to pass the return address)."}]
